why_not_core: This paper applies UQ to electromagnetics, not to biomechanics or implant design; no contact mechanics, stress shielding, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 电磁系统受几何和材料不确定性影响，需量化其对性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用Karhunen-Loève展开建模材料不确定性，比较扰动法、侵入/非侵入谱随机有限元及随机配点法。
summary_zh.result: 谱随机有限元法在计算效率上最优。
summary_zh.validation: 以蒙特卡洛方法为基准验证各随机方法的响应。

summary_en.motivation: Electromagnetic systems are subject to geometric and material uncertainties that affect performance, necessitating uncertainty quantification for robust design.
summary_en.method: Material uncertainty is modeled as a Gaussian random process via Karhunen-Loève expansion, and system response is analyzed using perturbation, intrusive/non-intrusive spectral stochastic FEM, and stochastic collocation.
summary_en.result: Spectral stochastic FEM is identified as the most computationally efficient among the compared methods.
summary_en.validation: Stochastic responses are validated against Monte Carlo simulations.

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate the computational bottleneck of constructing Kriging surrogate models for large data sets in time-critical engineering tasks.

summary_en.method: Mechanical testing of composite femurs with varying plate-stem overlap under torsion, axial compression, and 3-point lateral bending to measure strain and failure load.
summary_en.result: A plate extending at least two shaft diameters proximal to the stem tip exhibited the lowest strain, while a small gap led to highest strain and reduced fracture force.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation using fourth-generation composite sawbones and a collarless polished cemented stem.

summary_en.method: Maraging steel samples with various TPMS topologies and relative densities were fabricated by selective laser sintering and tested under compression.

why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or as-built surface characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过异质设计减少植入物应力屏蔽并促进骨长入。

summary_en.motivation: To minimize stress shielding and promote bone ingrowth through heterogeneous implant design with graded porosity and material variation.
summary_en.method: Prosthesis models with radial, axial, and mixed graded porosity and material distributions were designed and analyzed using finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: The radial variation model demonstrated the best performance in reducing stress shielding and improving implant stability.
summary_en.validation: The designs were validated through static structural analysis and consolidation analysis, comparing stress and strain distributions across models.

title: Comparison of Mechanical Properties of CAD/CAM–Milled and Selective Laser–Melted Ti-6Al-4V for Dental Superstructures
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM制造的Ti-6Al-4V力学性能，但针对牙科修复体，而非髋关节植入物的应力遮挡或多孔结构。
why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate porous structures for osseointegration, fatigue performance, or stress shielding in hip implants; it focuses on dental superstructures.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估选择性激光熔化制造牙科上部结构的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 比较SLM与数控铣削Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 两种方法均满足ISO标准，但SLM样品延展性降低。
summary_zh.validation: 根据ISO 22674标准进行拉伸测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether selective laser melting is suitable for fabricating dental superstructures.
summary_en.method: Mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V specimens produced by selective laser melting and numerically controlled milling were compared.
summary_en.result: Both groups met the ISO 22674 standard with strength >500 MPa and elongation >2%, but SLM samples showed reduced ductility.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via tensile testing according to ISO 22674 standard.

title: An efficient, globally convergent method for optimization under uncertainty using adaptive model reduction and sparse grids
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过自适应稀疏网格和降阶模型实现不确定条件下的高效优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, nor does it address contact mechanics or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解含不确定系数的PDE约束优化问题
summary_zh.method: 结合自适应稀疏网格和投影降阶模型，通过信赖域方法管理近似误差
summary_zh.result: 在最优流动控制问题中验证了全局收敛性并优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve PDE-constrained optimization problems under uncertainty by managing two sources of inexactness.
summary_en.method: A trust-region method that adaptively refines a dimension-adaptive sparse grid and a projection-based reduced-order model, using an asymptotic error bound to guarantee global convergence.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on an optimal flow control problem demonstrate global convergence and superior performance over previous alternatives.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on a model problem from optimal flow control under uncertainty.

title: Accelerating Experimental Design by Incorporating Experimenter Hunches

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出利用专家先验（单调趋势）加速贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用实验者直觉（单调趋势）提升贝叶斯优化效率，减少昂贵实验次数。
summary_zh.method: 两阶段高斯过程建模：第一阶段用单调性建模底层属性，第二阶段用虚拟样本建模目标优化函数。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真和真实实验（聚合物纤维长度、多孔支架孔隙率）中比标准贝叶斯优化收敛更快。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真和两个真实实验案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate experimental design by incorporating expert prior knowledge of monotonic trends into Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: A two-stage Gaussian process model: first stage models the underlying property with monotonicity, second stage uses virtual samples from the first to model the target optimization function with a correction factor.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves faster convergence than standard Bayesian optimization in both simulations and real-world experiments on polymer fiber length and porous scaffold porosity.
summary_en.validation: Validated through simulations and two real-world experimental design problems (polymer fiber length and 3D porous scaffold porosity).

title: A probabilistic framework for forward model-driven SHM
venue: White Rose Research Online (University of Leeds, The University of Sheffield, University of York)
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的概率框架和不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的构建，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学仿真。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on structural health monitoring (SHM) rather than biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations in implant optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决结构健康监测中损伤状态数据缺乏的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出结合多级不确定性集成和模型差异校正的概率框架
summary_zh.result: 框架能生成统计上代表不同损伤状态的预测，支持机器学习决策
summary_zh.validation: 理论框架描述，无具体实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the lack of damage state data in structural health monitoring by using validated physical models to generate training data for machine learning.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic framework is proposed that integrates multi-level uncertainty quantification and statistical techniques to account for model discrepancies across sub-system models.
summary_en.result: The framework enables the generation of statistically representative predictions across damage states, facilitating the inference of decision bounds for SHM.
summary_en.validation: The paper presents a theoretical framework and discussion of application considerations without experimental or numerical validation.

title: Uncertainty Quantification in Three Dimensional Natural Convection using Polynomial Chaos Expansion and Deep Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了深度神经网络作为替代模型进行不确定性量化的方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on natural convection in fluid dynamics, not on solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效量化高维输入不确定性对三维自然对流输出的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用多项式混沌展开和深度神经网络作为替代模型，处理随机边界温度。
summary_zh.result: 深度神经网络能以较少模拟次数达到合理精度，节省计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准案例（不同随机维度）进行训练和测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify the impact of high-dimensional input uncertainties on outputs of a 3D natural convection problem.
summary_en.method: Polynomial chaos expansion and deep neural networks are employed as surrogate models, with the latter handling non-uniform stochastic boundary temperatures via domain decomposition.
summary_en.result: The deep neural network achieves reasonable accuracy with fewer simulations than PCE, significantly reducing computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark cases with varying stochastic dimensions (4, 8, 16, 32).

title: Scaling Gaussian Process Regression with Derivatives
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的高斯过程回归方法，可扩展到带导数的高维问题，对代理模型构建具有参考价值。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant-specific application, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决带导数的高斯过程回归在大规模数据下的计算瓶颈。
summary_zh.method: 使用快速矩阵向量乘法和主元Cholesky预条件迭代求解。
summary_zh.result: 显著降低计算复杂度，支持高维和大预算贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上测试收敛速度和预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the prohibitive cubic computational cost of Gaussian process regression with derivative observations for large datasets.
summary_en.method: Proposes iterative solvers with fast matrix-vector multiplications and pivoted Cholesky preconditioning to accelerate kernel learning and prediction.
summary_en.result: Achieves orders-of-magnitude reduction in iterations and enables scaling to high-dimensional problems and large evaluation budgets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks demonstrating convergence speed and prediction accuracy.

title: Prediction of Discretization of GMsFEM using Deep Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用深度学习替代多尺度有限元方法中的昂贵局部计算，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及不确定性量化或约束处理。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and the application is porous media flow rather than implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速多尺度有限元方法中随介质变化的离散化计算
summary_zh.method: 用神经网络学习渗透率场到GMsFEM离散量的映射
summary_zh.result: 神经网络能快速预测多尺度基函数并用于通道流问题
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验对比神经网络预测与原始GMsFEM结果

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the recomputation of GMsFEM discretizations when the permeability field varies.
summary_en.method: A deep neural network is trained to map the permeability field to the multiscale basis functions and coarse-scale parameters.
summary_en.result: The neural network predicts GMsFEM ingredients accurately and enables fast multiscale simulations for channelized porous media flow.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments compare the neural network predictions with the original GMsFEM solutions.

key_terms.zh: 广义多尺度有限元方法

title: Leveraging Gaussian Process and Voting-Empowered Many-Objective Evaluation for Fault Identification
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用高斯过程构建响应面替代有限元模型，并采用多目标优化进行故障识别，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模与多目标优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on structural health monitoring using impedance sensing.

summary_zh.motivation: 避免反复调用有限元模型，高效识别结构故障参数。
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程构建阻抗响应面，结合多目标模拟退火与投票机制进行故障识别。
summary_zh.result: 数值与实验案例验证了方法的有效性，能准确识别故障位置与严重程度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟和实验案例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To avoid repeated finite element analysis in fault identification by constructing surrogate models for impedance measurements.
summary_en.method: A many-objective optimization framework using Gaussian process-based response surfaces and a voting-empowered simulated annealing algorithm.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately identifies fault location and severity in both numerical and experimental case studies.
summary_en.validation: Validation via systematic numerical simulations and experimental tests on structural components.

title: Reduced order modeling of subsurface multiphase flow models using deep residual recurrent neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的DR-RNN与POD-DEIM结合的降阶建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no constraint handling; only point prediction without uncertainty quantification in the surrogate itself.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低地下多相流高保真模拟的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合POD-DEIM与深度残差循环神经网络构建降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 降阶模型在固定计算预算下比标准POD-Galerkin方法更准确稳定
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个随机渗透率场的蒙特卡洛不确定性量化测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of high-fidelity simulations for subsurface multiphase flow problems.
summary_en.method: A reduced order model combining proper orthogonal decomposition (POD), discrete empirical interpolation method (DEIM), and deep residual recurrent neural networks (DR-RNN).
summary_en.result: The proposed ROM achieves accurate and stable predictions with a fixed computational budget significantly lower than standard POD-Galerkin with DEIM.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two uncertainty quantification test cases using Monte Carlo simulation of subsurface flow with random permeability fields.

title: Combining Bayesian Optimization and Lipschitz Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法结合贝叶斯优化与Lipschitz优化，可提升黑箱函数优化效率，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合贝叶斯优化与Lipschitz优化以提升黑箱函数全局优化性能
summary_zh.method: 提出Lipschitz贝叶斯优化（LBO），在传统BO中融入Lipschitz连续性假设
summary_zh.result: LBO在多数数据集上表现优于或持平原BO方法，尤其改善了Thompson采样的过度探索问题
summary_zh.validation: 在15个数据集上使用4种采集函数进行数值实验对比

summary_en.motivation: To improve global optimization of black-box functions by combining Bayesian optimization with Lipschitz continuity assumptions.
summary_en.method: Proposes Lipschitz Bayesian Optimization (LBO), which integrates Lipschitz information into traditional BO algorithms without increasing asymptotic runtime.
summary_en.result: LBO performs similarly or substantially better than standard BO across 15 datasets, notably correcting the over-exploration issue of Thompson sampling.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on 15 datasets with 4 acquisition functions, comparing LBO variants against standard BO methods.

title: GPdoemd: a Python package for design of experiments for model discrimination
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于高斯过程替代模型的最优实验设计方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的采样效率优化。
why_not_core: Does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for surrogate-based optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高模型辨识中实验设计的效率，减少昂贵实验次数。
summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程替代黑箱模型，结合Jensen-Rényi散度设计新准则。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在经典和新测试实例上均表现良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently discriminate among rival mathematical models by designing maximally informative experiments with limited data.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Jensen-Rényi divergence-based design criterion and replaces black-box models with Gaussian process surrogates for gradient-free marginalization.
summary_en.result: The surrogate-based method achieves effective model discrimination on both classical and new test problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark instances, demonstrating improved experimental design efficiency.

title: IGA-based Multi-Index Stochastic Collocation for random PDEs on arbitrary domains
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过等几何分析扩展随机配点法，可处理任意形状域上的随机PDE，对生物力学中复杂几何的UQ有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or surrogate modeling for expensive FEA; it focuses on forward UQ for general PDEs with IGA.

summary_zh.motivation: 将MISC方法扩展到非方形/立方体计算域上的随机PDE。
summary_zh.method: 利用等几何分析（IGA）作为张量PDE求解器，集成到MISC框架中。
summary_zh.result: 数值算例展示了该方法在任意形状域上的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值算例验证精度和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Extend the Multi-Index Stochastic Collocation method to handle forward UQ for random PDEs on domains with arbitrary shapes beyond squares or cubes.
summary_en.method: Integrate isogeometric analysis (IGA) solvers, which are tensor-based and naturally compatible with MISC, into the combination technique formulation.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed IGA-MISC approach on non-trivial geometries.
summary_en.validation: Validated using standard numerical benchmarks on irregular domains.

title: Variational Monte Carlo - Bridging Concepts of Machine Learning and High Dimensional Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于统计学习的参数化PDE求解方法，可应用于不确定性量化，其理论框架和数值方法对生物力学代理模型构建具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks constraint handling, and focuses on theoretical convergence analysis rather than practical surrogate modeling for expensive simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维参数化PDE的不确定性量化问题
summary_zh.method: 基于经验风险最小化的统计学习方法，结合层次张量模型类
summary_zh.result: 统一收敛性分析结合了数值分析与统计误差，数值实验验证了方法性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过层次张量数值基准实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a statistical learning approach for parametric PDEs that addresses uncertainty quantification in high-dimensional settings.
summary_en.method: The method minimizes empirical risk over a chosen model class, with a unified convergence analysis combining approximation and statistical errors.
summary_en.result: The approach demonstrates applicability to a broad range of problems, with numerical experiments using hierarchical tensors showing effective performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on hierarchical tensor model classes.

title: [Selective laser sintering and performances of porous titanium implants].

summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和兔体内植入验证。

summary_en.motivation: To analyze the mechanical properties and biocompatibility of porous titanium implants fabricated by selective laser sintering and investigate the promotion of osseointegration by chitosan/hydroxyapatite composite coating.

why_not_core: This paper does not use a patient-specific femoral stem geometry, does not report stresses in Gruen zones, and does not include physiological muscle loading; it focuses on a generic cylindrical implant in trabecular bone.

summary_zh.validation: 与文献中的实验观察结果进行定性比较。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of press-fit, bone yielding, densification, and friction on the primary stability of a bone-implant system under cyclic loading.
summary_en.method: A nonlinear homogenized finite element model with elasto-plastic bone damage and densification, and unilateral contact with friction.
summary_en.result: The model captures experimentally observed primary stability in terms of stiffness, ultimate force, and damage progression, and quantifies micromotions for osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation compared with experimental observations from literature.

summary_en.method: A systematic review of clinical studies measuring bone mineral density changes in Gruen zones for four short-stem and two standard stem designs.
summary_en.result: Short-stem implants show more balanced bone remodelling, but all stems exhibit proximal bone loss; distinct patterns between short-stem designs indicate different load transfer mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review of clinical DXA data.

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical and radiographic mid-term outcomes of the COREN cementless hip system.
summary_en.method: A consecutive series of 200 primary THAs was prospectively followed for a minimum of 5 years.
summary_en.result: Harris hip scores improved significantly, no thigh pain was reported, and stress shielding occurred in 80.3% of cases without severe bone loss.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up with radiographic assessment.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how material parameter uncertainties affect the local stress and strain fields in crystal plasticity finite element simulations.

summary_en.motivation: To address the long-standing challenge of non-Gaussian correlated process variations in uncertainty quantification for integrated circuits and photonics.

summary_en.result: Achieves 2500x to 3000x speedup over Monte Carlo on 19-57 non-Gaussian correlated parameters, accurately predicting multi-modal output density functions.

summary_en.motivation: To combine the expressivity of deep neural networks with the uncertainty quantification of Gaussian processes for function approximation and PDE solution.
summary_en.method: Generalized NNGP with more hyperparameters trained via maximum likelihood, and derived an analytical iteration formula for the covariance function under error-function nonlinearity.
summary_en.result: NNGP matches GP accuracy on smooth functions and outperforms GP on non-smooth functions, while being comparable or superior to deep NN.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard function approximation and PDE benchmark problems against GP and fully-connected NN.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: 4 Senirkent Vocational School, University of Suleyman Demirel, Isparta - Turkey.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造多孔钛合金植入物的骨整合过程，但缺乏力学测试和应力遮挡分析，与用户关注的力学匹配和疲劳性能关联较弱。
why_not_core: This paper does not include mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or stiffness matching quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索渐进多孔结构促进骨整合的机制
summary_zh.method: 利用DMLS制造致密和渐变多孔Ti6Al4V植入物，植入羊颅骨12周
summary_zh.result: 渐变多孔植入物比致密植入物有更好的骨整合
summary_zh.validation: 动物实验(SEM观察)

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the osseointegration process of transitive porous Ti6Al4V implants compared to massive ones.
summary_en.method: Implants were fabricated via direct metal laser sintering and surgically implanted into sheep skulls for 12 weeks.
summary_en.result: Transitive porous implants exhibited superior osseointegration with bone cell ingrowth into the inner region.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal study with SEM analysis.

title: Enhancing the Osteogenic Differentiation and Rapid Osseointegration of 3D Printed Ti6Al4V Implants via Nano-Topographic Modification.
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了3D打印钛合金植入物的纳米表面修饰促进骨整合，但缺少应力屏蔽分析和力学测试，仅与用户方向中的生物相容性部分相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or as-built surface morphology characterization, which are core to the AM biomedical materials direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速3D打印钛合金植入物的骨整合
summary_zh.method: 构建纳米拓扑表面修饰3D打印Ti6Al4V植入物
summary_zh.result: 纳米修饰促进BMSCs成骨分化及体内快速骨整合
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠股骨髁体内模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance rapid osseointegration of 3D printed Ti6Al4V implants via nano-topographic surface modification.
summary_en.method: Nano-topographic surfaces were constructed on 3D printed Ti6Al4V implants to improve biological responses.
summary_en.result: Nano-topographic modification favored BMSCs adhesion and osteogenic differentiation, accelerating in vivo osseointegration in a rat femoral condyle model.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rat model.

title: Effect of porous orthopaedic implant material and structure on load sharing with simulated bone ingrowth: A finite element analysis comparing titanium and PEEK.
venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials

corresponding_authors.name: R Dana Carpenter
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Colorado Denver, Denver, CO, USA. Electronic address: dana.carpenter@ucdenver.edu.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接比较了多孔PEEK和钛植入物在骨长入过程中的载荷分担和应力屏蔽，但缺乏LPBF制造和机械测试。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多孔PEEK与钛对骨-植入物界面的力学影响。
summary_zh.method: 建立有限元模型模拟骨长入过程，比较两种材料的载荷分担。
summary_zh.result: 多孔PEEK显著提高骨组织载荷分担比例和局部应变。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元模拟，未进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how porous PEEK and titanium implant materials affect load sharing with bone tissue during osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Finite element models of porous implant-bone interfaces were created to compare load transfer under compression, tension, and shear with simulated bone ingrowth.
summary_en.result: Porous PEEK substantially increased the load share transferred to bone and induced higher local tissue strains compared to porous titanium.
summary_en.validation: The study is based on finite element simulations without experimental validation.

title: Different models for simulation of mechanical behaviour of porous materials.
venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials
first_author_affiliation: Department of Engineering and Materials Science and Transportation, University of Seville, Av. Camino de los Descubrimientos s/n, 41092 Seville, Spain. Electronic address: sergiomunoz@us.es.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Engineering and Materials Science and Transportation, University of Seville, Av. Camino de los Descubrimientos s/n, 41092 Seville, Spain. Electronic address: sergiomunoz@us.es.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔钛的力学行为模拟，但与LPBF增材制造和疲劳性能无关。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or as-built morphology for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解多孔钛的力学行为以减轻应力遮挡效应。
summary_zh.method: 建立三种2D有限元模型，分别采用规则圆孔、随机椭圆孔和半随机分布。
summary_zh.result: 模型预测与实验数据吻合较好，弹性模量随孔隙率增加而降低。
summary_zh.validation: 与空间保持法制备的多孔钛实验数据对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the mechanical behavior of porous titanium for reducing stress shielding in bone replacement implants.
summary_en.method: Three versions of a 2D finite element model were developed with different pore geometries: periodic circular, random elliptic, and semi-random distribution.
summary_en.result: The models predicted the macroscopic elastic modulus with good agreement to experimental data across porosities from 28% to 66%.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing simulation results with experimental data from porous titanium fabricated by the space-holder technique.

title: Clustering-Guided Gp-Ucb for Bayesian Optimization

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, POSTECH, Korea

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进贝叶斯优化的聚类引导方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond UCB, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高贝叶斯优化在非光滑目标函数上的性能，避免陷入局部极值。
summary_zh.method: 对GP后验均值和标准差进行聚类，结合GP-UCB选择下一个采样点。
summary_zh.result: 在多种函数上减少了陷入局部极值的风险，且无需复杂辅助优化。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值测试函数上进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve Bayesian optimization for objective functions with sharp peaks and valleys, reducing the risk of local optima.
summary_en.method: Clustering is applied to the posterior mean and standard deviation from GP regression, then combined with GP-UCB to select the next query point.
summary_en.result: The method alleviates entrapment in local extrema across various test functions with minimal auxiliary optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmark functions.

why_not_core: This paper does not cover LPBF fabrication, porous structure design, stress shielding, or mechanical testing (static or fatigue).

summary_zh.motivation: 评估含锶涂层与商用SLActive表面在早期骨愈合中的表现
summary_zh.method: 在兔股骨髁植入Ti-Sr-O涂层、SLActive和纯钛种植体，2周后组织形态学分析
summary_zh.result: Ti-Sr-O涂层在骨形成和骨-种植体接触方面优于SLActive和纯钛
summary_zh.validation: 兔体内动物实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To compare the early bone healing performance of a strontium-releasing Ti-Sr-O coating with a commercial SLActive surface.

why_not_core: This paper uses powder metallurgy (PM) instead of LPBF, does not fabricate porous structures, and lacks fatigue testing and surface roughness characterization.

summary_en.result: Ball-milled powders sintered at 1550°C achieved full density, with compressive yield strength of 1058 MPa, elastic modulus of 50.8 GPa, and grade 0 cytotoxicity.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated by compression testing, and biocompatibility by in vitro cytotoxicity tests on MC3T3-E1 cells.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Imperial College London, London, SW7 2AZ, UK

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于容差的Pareto最优方法用于结构识别中的不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多目标优化与不确定性处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling or expensive simulation sampling efficiency; it focuses on structural identification with experimental data, not implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 结构参数识别中需量化不确定性，考虑响应灵敏度、测量误差和重复性。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于容差的Pareto最优框架，将重复性纳入多目标优化。
summary_zh.result: 得到参数空间区域而非单值解，有效区分可识别与高不确定性参数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过砌体面板实验验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Structural parameter identification requires uncertainty quantification that accounts for response sensitivity, measurement error, and test repeatability.
summary_en.method: A tolerance-based Pareto dominance definition is introduced within a multi-objective framework to incorporate repeatability and experimental uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The identification yields a region in parameter space compatible with data, effectively discriminating identifiable parameters from those with high uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on an experimental masonry panel test.

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了贝叶斯多保真度方法在心脏电生理不确定性量化中的应用，其方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模与UQ。

summary_en.motivation: To enable fast uncertainty quantification of activation sequences in patient-specific cardiac electrophysiology within clinically acceptable time constraints.

summary_en.motivation: Pump scheduling optimization in water distribution networks is computationally expensive due to nonlinearities and binary decisions, requiring efficient global optimization.

title: The Proximal and Distal Femoral Canal Geometry Influences Cementless Stem Anchorage and Revision Hip and Knee Implant Stability
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了不同股骨柄设计在骨缺损模型中的初始稳定性，但未量化应力遮挡或微动值。
why_not_core: Does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion values, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同股骨翻修柄设计在骨缺损中的锚定原理和初始稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 在合成股骨中植入四种不同设计的非骨水泥柄，进行CT分析和轴向/扭转刚度及抗迁移测试。

summary_en.validation: Clinical DEXA measurements with statistical comparison across implant groups.

title: DIFFERENCE OF STEM SUBSIDENCE AND CEMENT BEHAVIOUR IN THE VARIOUS THICKNESSES OF BONE CEMENT: AN EXPERIMENTAL STUDY USING A COLLARLESS POLISHED TAPERED STEM

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨骨水泥厚度对CPT股骨柄下沉和水泥行为的影响

summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试，微CT三维测量

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of cement mantle thickness on stem subsidence and cement behavior in cemented total hip arthroplasty using a collarless polished tapered stem.
summary_en.method: Composite femurs were implanted with CPT stems of varying sizes to create different cement mantle thicknesses; tantalum markers were injected into the cement, and specimens were subjected to 500,000 cycles of dynamic loading with micro-CT measurements before and after loading.
summary_en.result: Stem subsidence correlated positively with cement thickness; horizontal cement displacement correlated negatively with thickness; effective radial creep occurred when cement mantle was less than 2.5 mm thick and occupation ratio exceeded 60%.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing with micro-CT-based three-dimensional measurement of tantalum ball movement.

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the effect of selective laser melting parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of cp-Ti for biomedical implant applications.

summary_en.result: The SLM-processed samples exhibited increased strength due to low porosity and acicular martensitic structure, but ductility showed high scatter attributed to stratified porosity distribution.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated against the ISO 5832-2 standard for surgical metallic implants.

title: Collared Vs. Collarless Total Hip Arthroplasty In Both Direct Anterior And Direct Lateral Approach Surgery: A Prospective Cohort Comparison Study
relevance_to_user: 该论文关注股骨柄的领圈设计对术后下沉的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或有限元分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion via FEA, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it is a clinical migration study without biomechanical modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较有领和无领股骨柄在直接前路和直接外侧入路中的术后下沉差异。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性队列研究，使用RSA评估术后2-4周内的股骨柄迁移。
summary_zh.result: 无领柄下沉显著大于有领柄，但患者报告结果无差异。
summary_zh.validation: 临床RSA测量验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare early postoperative subsidence between collared and collarless femoral stems in THA via two surgical approaches.
summary_en.method: Prospective cohort study using radiostereometric analysis (RSA) to measure stem migration within the first 2-4 weeks post-surgery.
summary_en.result: Collarless stems exhibited significantly greater subsidence than collared stems, with no differences in patient-reported outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Clinical RSA measurements in patients.

title: Characteristics of Biometallic Alloy to Additive Manufacturing Using Selective Laser Melting Technology
first_author_affiliation: Material Science and Technology Center, Nuclear and Energy Research Institute, Sao Paulo, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: Marcello Vertamatti Mergulhão
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Material Science and Technology Center, Nuclear and Energy Research Institute, Sao Paulo, Brazil

relevance_to_user: 本文研究了Co-Cr-Mo合金的SLM成形参数和力学性能，但缺乏多孔结构、疲劳测试及表面形貌分析，未涉及植入物应力屏蔽适配。
why_not_core: No porous structure for stress shielding mitigation, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Co-Cr-Mo合金粉末特性及SLM成形参数
summary_zh.method: 气雾化粉末分级表征并SLM制备拉伸试样
summary_zh.result: 20-50 μm粉末流动性最佳，SLM试样力学性能符合生物医用要求
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To characterize powder properties of Co-Cr-Mo alloy for selective laser melting in biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Sieved gas-atomized powders into three granulometric ranges and fabricated tensile specimens via SLM.
summary_en.result: Powders in 20-50 μm range exhibited superior flowability and packing density, and SLM specimens achieved acceptable mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical tensile testing of SLM-fabricated specimens.

title: Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification of Physical Models in Thermal-Hydraulics System Codes
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯校准和高斯过程元建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on nuclear thermal-hydraulics, not on implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化热工水力系统代码中物理模型参数的不确定性
summary_zh.method: 结合全局敏感性分析、高斯过程元建模和贝叶斯校准
summary_zh.result: 校准后参数后验分布能约束先验不确定性，且保持名义值在后验区间内
summary_zh.validation: 在FEBA再淹没实验数据上验证校准结果

summary_en.motivation: To objectively quantify the uncertainty of physical model parameters in thermal-hydraulics system codes using experimental data.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic framework integrating global sensitivity analysis, Gaussian process metamodeling, and Bayesian calibration with MCMC sampling.
summary_en.result: The calibration scheme with a model bias term constrained prior uncertainties while keeping nominal parameter values within the posterior interval.
summary_en.validation: Validated by propagating posterior samples through FEBA reflood experiments and comparing with measured outputs.

title: An optimization and uncertainty quantification framework for patient-specific cardiac modeling
venue: Iowa State University Digital Repository (Iowa State University)
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了结合优化与不确定性量化的框架，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型与约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiac modeling rather than implant biomechanics, and does not address stress shielding, micromotion, or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决心脏模型参数调优的计算成本与数值不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合粒子群与模式搜索优化算法，结合代理模型进行概率采样。
summary_zh.result: 在合成与真实数据上准确复现目标输出分布，优化结果在误差容限内。
summary_zh.validation: 使用合成数据与临床/动物数据验证框架的准确性与适应性。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost and numerical uncertainty in tuning patient-specific cardiac models for clinical deployment.
summary_en.method: A hybrid particle swarm and pattern search optimization algorithm combined with surrogate-based probabilistic sampling for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately reproduced target output distributions in synthetic and real-world cases, with optimized results within acceptable error tolerances.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using synthetic test cases and real patient/canine data, demonstrating accurate reproduction of reference inputs and output distributions.

title: Adaptive Selection of Gaussian Process Model for Active Learning in Expensive Optimization.
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了自适应选择高斯过程模型进行主动学习的方法，可应用于昂贵优化问题，与用户关注的代理模型和不确定性量化方向相关。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on general expensive optimization without application to FEA or biomechanical implant design, and lacks validation on biomedical or structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵优化问题中单一代理模型适应性不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应选择高斯过程模型策略，根据局部特征动态切换模型
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准测试上提高了优化效率与鲁棒性
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准函数测试验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To address the limitation of using a single Gaussian process model for expensive optimization problems where local characteristics vary.
summary_en.method: An adaptive model selection framework that dynamically chooses among multiple Gaussian process models based on local features during active learning.
summary_en.result: The proposed method improves optimization efficiency and robustness across several benchmark functions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark functions commonly used in optimization literature.

title: Active learning methods for reliability analysis of engineering systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于工程系统的可靠性分析，其主动学习方法可迁移至植入物设计的可靠性评估。
why_not_core: Does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高工程系统可靠性分析的效率，减少昂贵仿真调用。
summary_zh.method: 采用主动学习策略，自适应选择训练样本构建代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 在多个工程案例中显著降低了仿真次数，同时保持精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例和工程案例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of reliability analysis for engineering systems by reducing the number of expensive simulations.
summary_en.method: Employs active learning strategies to adaptively select training samples for constructing surrogate models.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates significant reduction in simulation calls while maintaining accuracy across multiple engineering cases.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks and engineering case studies.

title: Active Learning for Regression Tasks with Expected Model Output Changes.
first_author_affiliation: Friedrich Schiller University Jena, Jena, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Christoph Käding
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Friedrich Schiller University Jena, Jena, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习方法可用于减少仿真采样成本，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on general regression tasks with expected model output changes.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少回归任务中标注样本的获取成本。
summary_zh.method: 基于期望模型输出变化选择最具信息量的样本。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准数据集上提高了采样效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归数据集上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the annotation cost in regression tasks by selecting informative samples.
summary_en.method: Proposes an active learning strategy that selects samples based on the expected change in model output.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates improved sampling efficiency on several benchmark regression datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on standard regression benchmarks.

title: A study of fatigue notch sensibility on titanium alloy TiAl6V4 parts manufactured by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: CEMMPRE, Department of Mechanical Enginnering, University of Coimbra, Rua Luís Reis Santos, 3030-788, Coimbra, Portugal

corresponding_authors.name: L.P. Borrego
corresponding_authors.affiliation: CEMMPRE, Department of Mechanical Enginnering, University of Coimbra, Rua Luís Reis Santos, 3030-788, Coimbra, Portugal

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造Ti6Al4V的疲劳性能，对植入物疲劳评估有参考价值，但未涉及应力遮挡或多孔结构。
why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造Ti6Al4V合金的疲劳性能，为其在生物医学中的应用提供依据。
summary_zh.method: 采用应变控制疲劳试验，测试光滑和缺口试样，进行拉伸和SEM分析。
summary_zh.result: 材料呈现应变软化行为，低过渡寿命，缺口敏感因子随寿命增加。
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳试验和断口SEM验证力学性能和失效机理。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the fatigue behavior of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V alloy for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Strain-controlled fatigue tests were conducted on smooth and notched round specimens, with tensile tests and SEM fractography.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited strain-softening, a low transition life of ~250 reversals, and a notch sensitivity factor increasing with fatigue life.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and SEM analysis validated the fatigue properties and failure mechanisms.

title: A novel hybrid 3D-printed titanium scaffold for osteogenesis in a rabbit calvarial defect model.
first_author_affiliation: Plastic Surgery Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical CollegeNo. 33, Badachu Road, Shijingshan District, Beijing 100144, China

corresponding_authors.name: Bo Yin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Plastic Surgery Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical CollegeNo. 33, Badachu Road, Shijingshan District, Beijing 100144, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印钛合金支架的骨再生，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳性能或表面粗糙度等关键方向。
why_not_core: No stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no LPBF fabrication details, and no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高多孔钛合金支架的骨再生能力
summary_zh.method: 在多孔钛合金孔隙中构建明胶/纳米羟基磷灰石微支架
summary_zh.result: 微支架促进体内外成骨，Gel:nHA=1:1组效果最佳
summary_zh.validation: 兔颅骨缺损模型体内实验及细胞实验

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the osteogenic capacity of porous titanium scaffolds by incorporating bioactive micro-scaffolds.
summary_en.method: Gelatin and nano-hydroxyapatite micro-scaffolds were fabricated within the pores of porous titanium alloy via a hybrid 3D-printing approach.
summary_en.result: The composite scaffolds, especially with Gel:nHA=1:1, significantly improved cell attachment, proliferation, osteogenic gene expression, and new bone formation in a rabbit calvarial defect model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays (MC3T3-E1) and in vivo rabbit calvarial defect model with micro-CT and histological analysis.

title: A Framework for Miniaturized Mechanical Characterization of Tensile, Creep, and Fatigue Properties of SLM Alloys
venue: Journal of International Crisis and Risk Communication Research
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM合金的小型化力学测试方法，包括拉伸、蠕变和疲劳，但未涉及生物医学植入物或应力遮挡问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统力学测试耗时耗材，需要更经济的SLM材料表征方法
summary_zh.method: 采用小冲杆测试结合数值模拟和逆方法，提出新型循环测试方案
summary_zh.result: SPT能有效追踪SLM材料在不同状态下的力学性能变化
summary_zh.validation: 与传统测试结果对比，并通过数字显微镜观察断口形貌

summary_en.motivation: Traditional mechanical testing is time-consuming and costly, necessitating a more economical method for characterizing SLM materials.
summary_en.method: A framework using small punch testing combined with numerical simulation and inverse method via least squares is developed, including a novel cyclic test for fatigue.
summary_en.result: SPT effectively tracks the evolution of mechanical properties of SLM materials under different orientations and processing states.
summary_en.validation: Results are validated by comparison with traditional testing and digital microscopy of fracture morphology.

title: In vitro and in vivo evaluations of mechanical properties, biocompatibility and osteogenic ability of sintered porous titanium alloy implant
first_author_affiliation: Beijing 100853

corresponding_authors.name: Zhongli Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beijing 100853

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔钛合金植入物的力学性能、生物相容性和成骨能力，但未涉及LPBF制造、疲劳测试或表面粗糙度。
why_not_core: This paper uses sintering, not LPBF, and lacks fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, and stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发具有良好力学和生物性能的多孔钛合金植入物。
summary_zh.method: 通过烧结制备不同孔隙率的多孔钛合金，并测试力学和生物学性能。
summary_zh.result: 75%孔隙率的合金具有最优力学性能和骨长入能力。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内动物实验验证生物相容性和成骨能力。

summary_en.motivation: To develop porous titanium alloy implants with optimal mechanical and biological performance for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium alloys with different porosities were fabricated via sintering, and their mechanical properties, biocompatibility, and osteogenic ability were evaluated.
summary_en.result: The alloy with 75% porosity exhibited the best combination of mechanical properties and bone ingrowth.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo animal implantation were conducted to validate biocompatibility and osteogenic ability.
